name: Echo
description: The pointer leaves copies of itself behind. Each echo is the real cursor, stamped where the pointer was a moment ago and tinted further along the spectrum as it ages, from cyan just behind the tip to rose at the end of the trail. Move quickly and they spread out into separate ghosts, move slowly and they gather into one soft smudge. A click throws the whole line of echoes bright for an instant.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Echoes
parameters.description: How many copies trail behind the pointer

parameters.name: Lifetime
parameters.description: How far back in time the last echo sits (seconds)

parameters.name: Opacity
parameters.description: Brightness of the echo just behind the pointer

parameters.name: Tint
parameters.description: How far each echo is pushed toward its spectrum colour, 0 to leave the cursor's own colours

parameters.name: Glow
parameters.description: Soft light around each echo, 0 to leave only the cursor shape

parameters.name: Activation speed
parameters.description: Pointer speed below which no echoes are drawn (px per second), 0 to always draw

parameters.name: Smoothing
parameters.description: How much the path is smoothed before the echoes are placed on it

parameters.name: Click flare
parameters.description: Brightness a click adds to every echo, 0 to disable
